If we have a lot of frames to transmit at once
to only tell the DMA engine about them on the last
fragment/frame to avoid banging the IO too much. This
patch allows implementation such an optimisation by
telling the driver when more frames can be expected.

column2: this is used by mac80211 only on fragmented
but could also be used in the future on other

column1: frames when the queue was full and there are multiple
Note that drivers need to be careful when using this

column2: they need to kick their DMA engines not just
but also when the queue gets

column1: full so that progress can be made.
